session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none.

background_tasks.description: What the runtime still had running in the background when this happened, as it listed it: a command, a subagent. Each entry is the runtime's, with an id, a type, a status and a description, and the command of a shell or the type of a subagent. A task in one list and in no list after it has ended; the runtime reports no exit status and no time for it. Absent when the runtime reports no list.

message.description: The subagent's last message, as text.
